PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
THE RENT ACT, No. 7 OF 1972
REGULATIONS made by the Minister of Housing and Construction under Section 43 of the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972 readwith Sub-section (5) of Section 2 of that Act.
SAJITH PREMADASA,Minister of Housing and Construction.Colombo,27th July 2016.
Regulations
1. The Schedule to the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972 is hereby amended by the addition immediately after item 4thereof, of the following new items :-

“5.Any premises of which the landlord is a co-operative society registered under the Co-operativeSocieties Law, No. 5 of 1972 or any statute of a provincial council, the State, a public corporation, apublic authority or a company registered under the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 shall be exceptedpremises for the purpose of this Act.

6.Any premises of which the tenant is a local authority or a co-operative society registered under theCo-operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 or any statute of a provincial council, the State, a publiccorporation, a public authority or a company registered under the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 shallbe excepted premises for the purpose of this Act.”.
2. The Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1305/17 of September 9, 2003 is hereby rescindedwithout prejudice to anything done thereunder.
